points.description: States that homogeneous coordinates allow translation, rotation and scaling to all be represented in a uniform way as matrices (3x3 matrices for 2D), so translation (normally an addition) can be expressed as matrix multiplication.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says a matrix representation or mentions only some transformations without the idea of uniformity/single form.

points.description: States the benefit: transformations can be combined/concatenated into one matrix, making computation easier, simpler or more efficient (optimization) for the computer.
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely says it is easier or better without linking to computation/efficiency or combining.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both the uniform matrix representation of translation, rotation and scaling, and the benefit of easier or more efficient computation. Give part marks for a vague or halfway statement, such as only "uses matrices" or only "easier". Give no marks for wrong or unrelated ideas, such as saying it is for 3D only.
